skills.trigger: When evaluating bilateral pulmonary opacities to determine symmetry and correlate with clinical history.
steps: Identify the specific lung zones (e.g., upper, middle, lower) containing hypotransparencies or opacities on both hemithoraces.
Compare the size, density, and extent of the findings between the left and right sides to assess for asymmetry.
Distinguish between symmetric distribution (suggesting systemic/chemical etiologies) and asymmetric dominance (suggesting focal progression or persistence of unilateral disease like pneumonia).
